summary: Blockbench 5.2.2 web app (low-poly 3D model editor), with six seeded projects open as tabs. Saved views: (1) edit-mode: the default Edit workspace for red_panda, with the UV editor, Textures panel, 3D viewport, Transform panel and Outliner; (2) animate-mode: Animate mode with the walk animation selected and the leg_front_left bone chosen, so the timeline shows its keyframes; (3) paint-mode: the Paint workspace with brush tools, the texture canvas, Textures/Layers panel and the color picker/palette; (4) start-screen: the /?start new-tab screen with splash art, the Recover Models banner and the list of model formats; (5) plugins-dialog: the File > Plugins store with the plugin list and the featured overview. Text and role locators timed out on this app, so the replay steps click by x/y coordinates. All views replayed with similarity of at least 0.96. Not captured, because only five views are allowed: Settings/Keybindings dialogs and Display mode for Java block models.
